xBRIEFInfo.author: overdeck/0.0.0
xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-5589: Gate admission counts CPU-pinned workloads as host pressure: PSI is high while 20 of 24 cores are idle

plan.title: Gate admission counts CPU-pinned workloads as host pressure: PSI is high while 20 of 24 cores are idle
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: sampleQualityGatePressure in src/lib/cloister/quality-gate-admission.ts marks the host pressured whenever CPU PSI some avg10 reaches the start threshold (or, without PSI, load per core reaches 1). PSI and load are system-wide and count tasks that wait only because a taskset affinity mask or cgroup quota confines them to a few cores. On 2026-11-21 seven encodes pinned to 4 of 24 cores read PSI 35 at 44 % utilization, and every local quality gate waited on 'CPU pressure' for over an hour while 20 cores were idle.
narratives.Proposal: Extract the pressure decision into a pure function isQualityGateCpuPressured in src/lib/cloister/quality-gate-cpu.ts (the admission module is 997 of its 1000-line cap), then add QUALITY_GATE_CONTENDED_UTILIZATION_FLOOR = 0.5: pressured = utilization >= 0.75 || (utilization >= 0.5 && contended), with the same floor on the load-average fallback. Add a PAN-5589 paragraph to the admission module header, rewrite the three sample tests that asserted PSI-alone pressure at 0 % utilization so they run at 60 %, add the issue's four cases plus boundary tests, and document the rule in docs/PIPELINE-GATES.md, configuration/memory-governor.mdx, the schema comment and changelog.d/pan-5589.md.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No new resources.* config key for the 0.5 floor.
- No affinity-aware or per-core sampling (/proc/stat per core, cgroup cpusets, sched_getaffinity).
- No change to the 0.75 utilization trigger, the PSI start threshold default (25), or the CPU bypass bound and its clock (PAN-5588 owns the clock).
- No change to src/lib/cloister/cpu-pressure.ts / assessCpuPressure (lane launches, agent-start warning, Flywheel hold).
- No change to the QualityGatePressureSample shape or the cpu wait-reason ticket format.
- No move of the admission file helpers (publishExclusive, replaceFile, readJson, unlinkIfExists, fileAgeMs); PAN-5588 extracts those.
- No allowlist row or cap raise in scripts/file-size-allowlist.txt.
- No deletion or skipping of any existing test; no edits to admission test describe blocks other than 'sampleQualityGatePressure (PAN-4311)'.

autoDecisions.summary: The three existing sampleQualityGatePressure cases that assert pressured: true from PSI or load at 0 % utilization are rewritten in place to run at 60 % utilization; every other admission test stays byte-for-byte unchanged.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue's own fix and its first AC case (PSI 35, utilization 0.44 -> false) contradict those three cases, so 'existing admission tests pass unchanged' can only mean the queue/slot/memory/fairness/bypass tests, which inject samplePressure. Rewriting at 60 % keeps the PSI-threshold, configured-threshold and load-fallback coverage.

autoDecisions.summary: The pressure decision moves to a pure function isQualityGateCpuPressured in quality-gate-cpu.ts; sampleQualityGatePressure and cpuTotals stay in the admission module.
autoDecisions.rationale: quality-gate-admission.ts is 997 lines against a 1000-line cap with no allowlist row, and the issue asks for a header paragraph there. Moving only the thresholds and decision frees 7 lines, avoids an import-path change for tests, and stays clear of PAN-5588's file-helper extraction.

autoDecisions.summary: The 0.5 floor is a code constant, not a config key.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue names a new constant of 0.5 and asks for no setting.

autoDecisions.summary: Gate admission only; assessCpuPressure (governor, lanes, agent-start warnings) is left alone.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue scopes the fix to sampleQualityGatePressure. The governor uses PSI avg60 against different thresholds and its own callers; changing it is a separate decision.

narrative.Action: Follow PRD WI-1 exactly. In src/lib/cloister/quality-gate-cpu.ts add exported constants QUALITY_GATE_CPU_START_THRESHOLD = 0.75 and QUALITY_GATE_LOAD_PER_CORE_START_THRESHOLD = 1, an exported interface QualityGateCpuReading { cpuUtilization: number; loadPerCore: number; psiSomeAvg10: number | null }, and isQualityGateCpuPressured(reading, psiStartAvg10) that returns reading.cpuUtilization >= 0.75 || contended, where contended is PSI >= psiStartAvg10 when PSI is non-null, else loadPerCore >= 1 (today's rule, unchanged). In src/lib/cloister/quality-gate-admission.ts delete lines 47-50 (the two threshold consts and the two-line '// PAN-4311 D10:' comment), add isQualityGateCpuPressured to the './quality-gate-cpu.js' import on line 8, and replace the contended block plus pressured expression in sampleQualityGatePressure with pressured: isQualityGateCpuPressured({ cpuUtilization, loadPerCore, psiSomeAvg10 }, psiStartAvg10). quality-gate-cpu.ts must not import anything from quality-gate-admission.ts. Do not touch cpuTotals, the admission loop, the file helpers, or any test file.

narrative.Action: Follow PRD WI-2 exactly. In quality-gate-cpu.ts add exported QUALITY_GATE_CONTENDED_UTILIZATION_FLOOR = 0.5 with the PAN-5589 doc comment, change isQualityGateCpuPressured to: return true at utilization >= 0.75; return false below 0.5; otherwise return PSI >= psiStartAvg10 (load per core >= 1 when PSI is null). Update its doc comment and the DEFAULT_QUALITY_GATE_PSI_START_AVG10 doc comment as the PRD gives. In the quality-gate-admission.ts module header insert the four-line PAN-5589 paragraph after the line ending '`resources.quality_gate_psi_start_avg10`.' and before 'Admitted parents set OVERDECK_GATE_ADMITTED=1'; do not edit the PAN-5520 paragraph lines. In tests/unit/lib/cloister/quality-gate-admission.test.ts, only inside describe('sampleQualityGatePressure (PAN-4311)'), add the cpusAt(busy) helper (two mockReturnValueOnce calls on osMocks.cpus: four cores at zero, then user busy*100 / idle 100-busy*100), rewrite the three D7 cases in place at cpusAt(0.6) with the titles and expectations the PRD gives, leave 'lets PSI win over a high load per core' unchanged, and add the four PAN-5589 cases (PSI 35 at 0.44 -> false; PSI 35 at 0.6 -> true; PSI 5 at 0.8 -> true; no PSI, loadavg [4.8,0,0] on 4 cores at 0.44 -> false). Use toMatchObject({ pressured }) and toBeCloseTo for cpuUtilization. Never delete, skip or .only a test.
